thread:
tara_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the candidate carousel for the Onramp pilot. Goals: 8-12 orgs, coverage across e-comm / finserv / internal platform, and one edge-case on-prem customer. Can folks share current slots and any gating concerns?

leo_eng: I have 3 slots from infra (low-latency routing + Dedicated smoke). Two are internal infra teams we can recruit.

mason_prodops: We can commit 2 enterprise-focused seats (security review required). Need to confirm if they can take Full Private or just VPC.

sophie_research: For feedback loops, propose 2-week cadence: initial intake survey -> 1-week usage window -> qualitative 30m interview -> NPS + product metrics. Want to run a quick pilot eval rubric.

emily_cs: From CS: prefer 1 onboarding concierge per org for first month. Also we should surface clear success criteria to partners (SLOs + integration milestones).

tara_pm: Agreed. Draft success criteria (WIP):
- Integration: sample app up in <2 weeks
- Latency: <200ms p50 on hosted routes (where applicable)
- Qualitative: avg rating >= 4/5 on utility in first trial
- Ops: no more than 2 escalations to infra per org in first 30 days

leo_eng: Quick note: latency target depends on model size. If they pick a 70B variant we should set separate target or offer a quantized variant.

mason_prodops: Security gating: all Private candidates must complete our ATO checklist. I can draft a short checkbox we send with invites.

sophie_research: Can we instrument a minimal telemetry bundle (counts, latencies, error codes) and tie it to the partner id? Need to confirm PII constraints.

beta-coordinator-bot: Reminder: recruitment spreadsheet updated. 4 open invite slots, 2 pending legal, 1 flagged for region (EU).

emily_cs: Template language idea for invites: "Participate in Redwood Onramp pilot — we'll provide dedicated onboarding, priority routing, and direct product feedback channels. Expect ~3 sessions and 2 short surveys." Keep it concise.

tara_pm: Scope negotiation: we should limit custom infra work during pilot — ask partners to use standard deployment options (Hosted/Dedicated/VPC) only. Any bespoke infra requests move to commercial path. Thoughts?

leo_eng: +1. We can't offer custom runtime changes in pilot window. We can accept config tweaks (batching, quant profiles) but no kernel-level changes.

mason_prodops: For Private on-prem edge-case, we can make an exception but will gate on signed SOW and infra lead availability.

sophie_research: Evaluation rubric suggestion (short):
- Adoption (DAUs / org) — 30%
- Reliability (errors / 10k tokens) — 25%
- Latency vs baseline — 20%
- Qualitative feedback (interviews/surveys) — 25%
Can we all agree to that weighting?

emily_cs: Looks good. Add a customer impact note: their feedback should map to a named product story we commit to review post-pilot. Helps partners see value.

tara_pm: Timeline: invites out by Tue next week, onboarding starts the following Mon, 4-week pilot window, internal review 1 week after. Any blockers to that cadence?

leo_eng: Need one week to lock test infra and verify EU region capacity.

mason_prodops: Legal may need 5 business days for ATO on some partners — can we add a buffer in onboarding start?

tara_pm: OK will add a 7-day buffer. Revised plan: invites Tue, expected onboarding start +2 weeks to allow legal/ops.

sophie_research: I'll prepare intake survey and interview scripts. Will also produce a compact eval dashboard (CSV + short slide deck).

emily_cs: I'll draft the invite copy + onboarding checklist and hand to @mason_prodops for ATO items.

tara_pm: Thanks. Action items:
- leo_eng: confirm infra capacity and EU region by EOD Fri
- mason_prodops: draft ATO checklist and share with legal by EOD Thu
- sophie_research: intake survey + rubric by Mon
- emily_cs: invite + onboarding checklist by Mon
- tara_pm: update recruitment spreadsheet and send invites Tue

beta-coordinator-bot: Will create calendar block for kickoff calls after invites are accepted.

leo_eng: FYI — if any partner requests lower latency than our default, we'll offer dedicated routing + caching config, documented in the onboarding playbook.

mason_prodops: One more: include a clear opt-out clause for partners re: data retention. We need consent for logs retention >30 days.

tara_pm: Good catch. I'll add that to the invite template.

emily_cs: :thumbsup: sounds like a plan.

sophie_research: Great — excited to start.

tara_pm: Closing thread. Will post the invite draft here once ready.
